field.label: Enabled
field.help: Enable this instance. Disabled instances are skipped on start and reconfigure.

field.label: Name
field.help: Display name for this instance in the table

field.label: Outbound Config (JSON)
field.help: xray-core outbound object. Use "Import VLESS link" above to auto-fill, or paste/write the outbound JSON directly. The backend wraps it with SOCKS5 inbound and routing on save.

field.label: SOCKS5 Listen Address
field.help: IP address xray-core binds for its SOCKS5 inbound. tun2socks connects here to forward all TUN traffic through the proxy. Use 127.0.0.1 (loopback, recommended), 0.0.0.0 (all interfaces), or any IP assigned to a real OPNsense interface (e.g. 192.168.1.1). Other 127.x.x.x addresses require a manual lo0 alias on FreeBSD and are not recommended.

field.label: SOCKS5 Port
field.help: Local loopback port xray-core binds for SOCKS5 inbound
field.hint: Default: 10808. tun2socks connects here to forward TUN traffic. Must not be used by another process.

field.label: TUN Interface
field.help: Virtual network interface created by tun2socks
field.hint: Default: proxytun2socks0. Must match the name in Interfaces → Assignments.

field.label: MTU
field.help: Maximum Transmission Unit for the TUN interface
field.hint: Default: 1500. Reduce to 1380 if large packets (e.g. SSH, large downloads) fail or are slow.

field.label: Bypass Networks
field.help: Comma-separated list of CIDR networks that should bypass the VPN tunnel and go direct. These networks will be routed via the 'direct' (freedom) outbound instead of the proxy.

field.label: Xray Log Level
field.hint: warning is recommended for production. Use debug only for troubleshooting — it generates a lot of output.
